Class BackgroundDependencyLoaderAttribute

Namespace: osu.Framework.Allocation
Assembly: osu.Framework.dll

Marks a method as the (potentially asynchronous) initialization method of a osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable, allowing for automatic injection of dependencies via the parameters of the method.

[MeansImplicitUse(ImplicitUseKindFlags.InstantiatedNoFixedConstructorSignature)]
[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Method)]
public class BackgroundDependencyLoaderAttribute : Attribute
